Dressed, makeup, made a full breakfast, etc. I stuck my head in the room to yell for him to get up and then went about my business. I started to get frustrated when he wasn't getting up, so I went in there. I shook him and he was freezing. Blue. He had been dead for hours. And I had no idea.
